headline: Weber slashes grill prices up to 20% off for July 4th
summary: Weber is offering discounts on grills, griddles, and smokers ahead of the July 4th holiday. Prices start at $499 for the Spirit E-325.
details: Weber is offering discounts on various grills, griddles, and smokers ahead of the July 4th holiday. The Spirit E-325 grill is available in propane for $499 (usually $549) or natural gas for $549 (usually $599).
The Spirit E-325 features three burners, a 360 square inch grilling surface, and a 90 square inch warming rack. It also has two searing zones with higher heat output for finishing steaks.
Weber's prices are generally cheaper than other retailers by about $50 on most of these picks. However, some local hardware stores like Home Depot or Ace may offer comparable prices.
caption:
Save up to 20% on Weber grills and griddles this July 4th!

Weber is offering discounts on various grills, griddles, and smokers ahead of the July 4th holiday. The Spirit E-325 grill is available in propane for $499 (usually $549) or natural gas for $549 (usually $599).

The Spirit E-325 features three burners, a 360 square inch grilling surface, and a 90 square inch warming rack. It also has two searing zones with higher heat output for finishing steaks.

Weber's prices are generally cheaper than other retailers by about $50 on most of these picks. However, some local hardware stores like Home Depot or Ace may offer comparable prices.
